semiconductor_relevance: High — ULVAC GmbH provides a comprehensive range of manufacturing equipment and solutions specifically for semiconductor processes.
summary: ULVAC GmbH specializes in manufacturing equipment for deposition, etching, and ashing processes in the semiconductor industry. They offer advanced solutions for MEMS, power devices, and thin film applications, serving the EMEA region from their headquarters in Munich, Germany.
capabilities: Sputtering and evaporation equipment for thin film applications
Plasma etching and ashing systems for semiconductor fabrication
Ion implantation and activation annealing solutions

regional_presence.Europe: ULVAC GmbH serves the EMEA region from its headquarters in Munich, Germany.
